title: Black Forest Labs Releases FLUX 3: A Multimodal Flow Model for Image, Video, Audio and Robot Action Prediction
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Black Forest Labs (BFL) has released FLUX 3, a multimodal foundation model that learns from images, videos and audio inside a single architecture. It is also the first FLUX model t...
body: Black Forest Labs has announced the release of Flux.3, a next-generation multimodal flow model capable of generating high-fidelity image, video, and audio assets from text prompts. Building on the architecture of their previous flow models, Flux.3 introduces unified latent space representations that allow seamless transitions between modalities during the generation process. This release is expected to lower the compute barrier for creators and researchers seeking unified media generation workflows, while delivering superior speed. The model supports a variety of open parameters, making it highly customizable for local setups.
